hypothesis: A fast authentic onset is distinguished by the ordered rise in directional microprice slope-velocity, not its absolute speed: CL jerk becomes aligned first, MCL jerk accepts, and TR/quote activity propagates without a contemporaneous spread-liquidity failure. Fake turns exhibit missing handoff, MCL-first transport noise, alternating jerk, or post-trigger collapse.

exact_derived_law.directional_velocity: the Stage-88 direction-signed microprice slope-velocity for one symbol and interval
exact_derived_law.velocity_jerk: current interval directional velocity minus the immediately preceding interval directional velocity
exact_derived_law.tr_acceleration: current interval microprice-TR velocity minus the immediately preceding interval microprice-TR velocity
exact_derived_law.quote_jerk: current interval quote-intensity acceleration minus the immediately preceding interval quote-intensity acceleration
exact_derived_law.spread_failure: spread elasticity becomes positive while directional velocity-jerk is non-positive
exact_derived_law.first_alignment_interval: the first post-baseline interval with positive direction-signed displacement and positive direction-signed slope-velocity; missing evidence remains unresolved
exact_derived_law.handoff: CL_LEADS when CL aligns in an earlier interval than MCL; SAME_INTERVAL when equal; MCL_LEADS when MCL aligns first; UNRESOLVED otherwise
exact_derived_law.sequence_shape: retain every jerk/TR/quote sign in frozen interval order; no magnitude threshold, score, union, or winner

categorical_hypotheses.ORDERED_IGNITION: CL_LEADS or SAME_INTERVAL, non-negative MCL acceptance jerk, no trigger-to-acceptance spread failure, and no directional sign reversal through propagation
categorical_hypotheses.TRANSPORT_REFUSAL: CL aligns but MCL remains unresolved or becomes adverse through acceptance
categorical_hypotheses.WHIPSAW: directional velocity-jerk alternates sign across trigger, spark, and acceptance
categorical_hypotheses.EXHAUSTION: closing trigger is aligned but spark or acceptance jerk collapses while TR/spread expands

future_action_boundary.after_count_pass: freeze matched controls and economic settlement before any chase, maturation, or fake-rejection action
never: invent direction or suppress risk reduction
infer depth, queue priority, identified cancellation, or colocated HFT
change order, sizing, capital, or crown authority from count morphology
